messages:
maya: incoming escalation from a customer (enterprise) - seeing p99 spikes and timeouts on Dedicated pool `dedicated-acme-1` since ~09:12 UTC. They've hit 5-10s p99 on generation endpoints. logs attached (link).

jordan: thanks. can you paste grafana snapshot + a couple of example request ids? want to see attach queue / scale-up traces.

maya: grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/acme/dedicated-1/snapshot/abc123
example reqs: gen_0x9a3, gen_0x9b1
summary: p50 stable, p95 1.2s -> 3.0s, p99 6s -> 11s after 09:12. error rate small but timeouts 504 increasing.

priya: looking at autoscaler traces - attach queue length spiked at 09:10, many attach attempts retried with exponential backoff. I see attach latencies hitting 25-60s and then timeouts. warmup durations also jumped for new nodes.

alex: hypothesis: two contributors - attach queue starvation (scale-up lag) + cold GPU warmup stretched (image pull / kernel init). we should do fast mitigations: 1) route this customer's traffic to fallback model variant (lower footprint) 2) manually attach 2 pre-warmed nodes to pool 3) temporarily raise pool burst cap for this org 4) enable fallback policy so requests hit hosted fallback if tails persist.

samir: I can manual-attach. running: `rwctl pool attach --pool dedicated-acme-1 --count 2 --type warm`

oncall-bot: job attach-ops-2265 started by samir. status: in-progress.

priya: I'm tailing attach controller logs: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/attach-controller --since=30m` shows repeated `timeout waiting for kernel-image` and `rate-limited attach attempt (backoff=8s)`. registry pull times spiked ~09:05-09:20.

samir: attach command returned success, nodes came up but warmup hit 80s for first GPU (kernel image pull delay). manual pre-pull helped on second node.

jordan: can we flip routing for this customer now? maya, can you coordinate customer comms?

maya: yes - I told them we have mitigation in flight. toggling fallback route now: `rwctl route update --org acme --fallback hosted-small-v2`

oncall-bot: route-update-789 applied.

priya: after manual attach + fallback, p99 dropped from ~11s to ~1.8s within 6 minutes. p95 back near baseline. attach queue length cleared.

alex: good. keep fallback until we root cause. initial RCA notes: intermittent registry latency + aggressive attach backoff without enough jitter -> thundering retries and queueing. Also our warmup path lacks pre-pull on some AMIs.

samir: filed quick rollback for kernel-image v2026.03.09 on nodes that show slow pulls. planning canary restart for controller to ensure new backoff jitter applied.

priya: created incident ticket INC-5567. action items: - add attach-queue alert (threshold > 5 for > 2m) - increase default jitter and cap in attach backoff - ensure pre-pull stage before marking node warm - reserved burst capacity for enterprise plans - add registry pull latency dashboard and alert

maya: customer updated: they saw clear improvement and will monitor. asked them to escalate if they see any more timeouts.

alex: I'll own follow-up PRs for backoff jitter + pre-pull. priy a can you follow up on image registry vendor?

priya: on it, opening vendor support ticket and adding test to CI for image pull timeout regression.

maya: leaving note on ticket and closing support escalation after 24h stable. thanks all :thumbsup:

samir: +1. will keep an eye on any reoccurrence during next auto-scale window.

oncall-bot: incident INC-5567 created by priya (severity=P1).
